notes.title: 2025 update coming soon
notes.notes:
Hello fellow players:

Today is the last day of 2024. All members of HexGameStudio wish you all good luck and good health in 2025!

The agreed three-month deadline for fixing bugs has expired, and today we uploaded the last updated version to fix bugs. Next, we will add more content, starting with voice acting. Your support is very important to us! Thank you for your love of our game.

HexGameStudio
